summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, Tabs, TabsRenderable); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (click spans appended last, skipped on zero-width early path) with width moved to fifth position and output now a single Text; Opacity now merges blended color into existing style so click metadata survives. Layout resolver unchanged because its Edge protocol already had size/min_size/fraction. Added tests: four underline tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and new tests/test_tabs.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css. Decisions to review: bar position uses displayed-tab indices (conflicts with spec's find_tab_by_name wording only when a duplicate name precedes); can_focus=True set on Tabs so it receives keys; each inactive span wrapped in its own Opacity; empty label strings become flexible (one cell). Static checks only: line lengths verified. Tests still need to be run.
